description.text: Production planning and expediting clerks distribute work orders, coordinate materials and progress, and handle material shortages and delays. See the O*NET 43-5061 tasks, 2025 United States wages, the BLS 2025–2035 projection, the Chinese wage evidence gap, and the fictional exercises.

subject.name: Production planning and expediting clerks
subject.summary: Production planning and expediting clerks coordinate work orders and material flow between departments according to the production schedule, distribute and adjust schedules, check progress and completion dates with supervisors, and compile records of inventory, cost, bottlenecks, and delays. Schedule changes must note resource conditions and the approver, and expediting must not replace safety or quality judgment.
